families.title: Superbells® Calibrachoa
families.desc: Self cleaning annuals that look like miniature petunias and bloom nonstop from planting until hard frost. Mounding and trailing, they are ideal spillers for containers and hanging baskets.

families.title: Double Superbells® Calibrachoa
families.desc: Rosebud like, fully double flowers that bloom continuously from planting until a hard frost. New growth naturally covers spent blooms, so there is no deadheading.

families.title: Ipomoea Sweet Potato Vine
families.desc: Fast growing, heat loving foliage in lime, chartreuse, near black and mahogany. A perfect spiller over baskets and window boxes, or a quick annual groundcover.

families.title: Supertunia Vista® Petunias
families.desc: Very vigorous, mounding petunias up to 1 foot tall that trail over the edges of baskets and large containers up to 4 feet by the end of the season. They act as both filler and spiller, and shine at the front or middle of garden beds. Medium sized flowers.

families.title: Supertunia® Mini Vista Petunias
families.desc: Vigorous petunias with a slightly mounded habit that act as both filler and spiller in containers. Excellent at the front of garden beds. Small flowers.

families.title: Supertunia® Petunias
families.desc: Vigorous petunias with a slightly mounded habit that fill and spill in containers and make excellent landscape plants near the front of beds. Medium to large flowers. Best seller and award winner, heat tolerant and long blooming.

families.title: Petunia Crazytunia
families.desc: Large, trumpet shaped blooms in bold colours. Mounded to semi trailing and mostly self cleaning; a light midseason trim keeps them tidy.

families.title: Petchoa Caliburst™
families.desc: Compact, trailing petchoa with 2 to 3 inch flowers that keep coming all season. No deadheading needed.

families.title: Petchoa SuperCal® Premium
families.desc: The vigour of petunias with the weather toughness of calibrachoa. Non sticky foliage drops old flowers naturally, so there is no deadheading. Continuous blooms from spring through late autumn.

families.title: Angelonia Sungelonia
families.desc: Known as summer snapdragon. Upright, uniform and well branched with glossy foliage. Exceptional heat, humidity and drought tolerance, deer resistant, and no deadheading.

families.title: Argyranthemum frutescens
families.desc: Cheerful daisies all season. A thriller for container gardens, landscape borders and mass plantings that attracts butterflies and bees.

families.title: Argyranthemum Sundurance
families.desc: Bright daisies on a bushy plant. Remove spent blooms to encourage continuous flowering.

families.title: Bacopa Everest Cherry Blast
families.desc: A trailing spiller for hanging baskets, window boxes and combination planters. Self cleaning; keep the soil evenly moist.

families.title: Bacopa Snowstorm®
families.desc: A dainty spiller or filler for hanging baskets, window boxes and combination planters. Trails up to 3 feet and is self cleaning. Keep the soil evenly moist.

families.title: Begonia NonStop
families.desc: Shade loving begonias with massive, rose like double blooms 3.5 to 4.5 inches wide. Blooms nonstop from late spring all the way to the first frost.

families.title: Bidens Goldilocks Rocks®
families.desc: An award winning bidens with large, bright golden yellow daisies up to 3 inches across. Compact, mounding and trailing, it flowers from spring through hard frost. Pairs well with petunias, calibrachoa and verbena.

families.title: Citrosa Mosquito Plant
families.desc: A scented geranium grown for its aromatic lacy foliage. Brush or crush the leaves to release the citrus scent. Toxic to cats and dogs.

families.title: Cleome Arona
families.desc: Airy, spidery blooms on a tall, fast growing annual that makes an excellent backdrop for gardens and borders. Heat and drought tolerant once established, and loved by bees, butterflies and hummingbirds.

families.title: Coleus ColorBlaze®
families.desc: Award winning coleus grown for vibrant, high impact foliage. Heat tolerant, deer resistant and well branched without pinching. Thrives in sun or shade, with more sun intensifying the colour.

families.title: Dahlia Dahlietta
families.desc: Compact, mounded dahlias with full, colourful blooms. Attract bees, butterflies and hummingbirds and are deer resistant. Snip faded flowers to encourage new blooms.

families.title: Dracaena Spikes
families.desc: A popular, low maintenance foliage plant used as the vertical thriller in the centre of pots, surrounded by filler and spiller annuals.

families.title: Euphorbia Diamond Snow™
families.desc: Airy clouds of tiny white flowers that make a soft filler in containers and mixed planters.

families.title: Felicia Daisy Forever Blue
families.desc: Sky blue daisies that bloom for a long season with easy care and no deadheading. Use in containers and landscapes.

families.title: Gaura
families.desc: Airy, butterfly shaped blooms on slender stems. Gaura Everlast suits beds, pots and borders, while Baby Butterfly is a dwarf, compact form with rich dark pink flowers from early summer into autumn.

families.title: Geranium Zonal Savannah
families.desc: A wonderful addition to containers or landscapes. Dark foliage provides a stunning backdrop to the blooms.

families.title: Gomphrena
families.desc: Papery, ball shaped blooms that flower continuously from early summer until frost, with no deadheading required.

families.title: Heliotrope Midnight Sky
families.desc: Dense clusters of deep royal blue purple flowers with a strong, sweet scent like vanilla and cherry pie. Deadhead regularly for continuous blooms.

families.title: Impatiens Double Glimmer™
families.desc: Fully double, miniature rose like blossoms on a mounded, spreading plant. Thrives in shade to partial sun; ideal for hanging baskets, containers and shaded beds. Water regularly.

families.title: Impatiens SunPatiens Compact
families.desc: Unlike traditional impatiens, SunPatiens love heat and direct sun, and also grow in shade. Self cleaning, resistant to downy mildew and tolerant of rain, wind, heat and humidity.

families.title: Lantana Heartland
families.desc: Compact, upright lantana that is vigorous and early blooming. Loves full sun and heat, and is generally deer and rabbit resistant.

families.title: Lobelia Laguna™
families.desc: A heat tolerant, mounding lobelia for containers, hanging baskets and borders. Self cleaning with no deadheading required.

families.title: Lobularia Snow Princess®
families.desc: A mounding, cascading plant covered in tiny, honey fragrant, snow white flowers. Because it is sterile, it blooms nonstop from early spring straight through to frost.

families.title: Nemesia
families.desc: A sweetly fragrant nemesia with an upright, mounded habit. Continuous blooms from spring through a hard frost, though flowering may slow in peak summer heat.

families.title: Osteospermum Summersmile
families.desc: African daisies bred to keep blooming through hot summer weather. Compact, bushy and heavily branched.

families.title: Pansy Cool Wave
families.desc: Trailing pansies with a long blooming season, from early spring right through summer and into autumn.

families.title: Plectranthus Magic Mona
families.desc: Large purple to lavender flower spikes over dark green leaves with purple undersides. Blooms abundantly in late summer and autumn. Ideal for part shade beds, patios and pots.

families.title: Salvia
families.desc: Tight, upright and rounded salvias that bloom and rebloom from mid spring through late fall.

families.title: Superbena® Verbena
families.desc: Great vigour, awesome branching and wonderful summer performance. Flowers are clustered in large umbels that cover the deep green foliage. Great in baskets, planters and landscape edging.

families.title: Verbena bonariensis Meteor Shower®
families.desc: An upright, densely branching thriller for containers or mass plantings. Clusters of violet lilac blooms appear from spring through hard frost. Low maintenance.

families.title: Graceful Grasses®
families.desc: Ornamental grasses that add height, movement and drama to containers and beds. A perfect thriller in the centre of a mixed pot.

families.title: Juncus ColorGrass & Eupatorium
families.desc: Height and texture for planters. Juncus adds blue green spikes or playful corkscrews, and Eupatorium Elegant Feather forms tall, feathery columns with good deer resistance.

families.title: Artemisia
families.desc: Silvery foliage that makes every colour around it glow. Garden Ghost is a hardy groundcover, Makana Silver forms a soft billowy mound with aromatic leaves, and Silver Cascade spills over pot edges.

families.title: Senecio Angel Wings
families.desc: A striking, low maintenance succulent grown for its large, silvery white, velvety leaves. Forms a neat clump. Let the soil dry out completely between waterings.

families.title: Senecio Winter Whispers
families.desc: Soft silver grey foliage that keeps its colour in bright sun. Compact and bushy; allow the soil to dry out between waterings.

families.title: Trailers
families.desc: The finishing touch for every basket and planter. These vines and trailers fill in quickly and cascade beautifully over the edges. Sedum Lemon Ball spills bright chartreuse.

families.title: Herbs
families.desc: Fresh flavour right outside the kitchen door. Ready to plant in pots or the garden.

families.title: Tomatoes
families.desc: Garden fresh tomatoes for every space: sweet small fruit varieties, a beefsteak, a bush slicer and a Roma for sauces.

families.title: 6 Pack Bedding Annuals
families.desc: Great value for filling beds and borders. Tall Rocket snapdragons have long sturdy stems for cutting, marigolds range from dwarf to very tall, and Crestar zinnias are an award winner.
